title: AgentReady & WebSec Bulk Domain Auditor Input
description: Audit up to 100 domains or URLs in one fast browserless run for AI-readiness (robots.txt 12 AI crawlers, /llms.txt, agent.json, JSON-LD) and web security (HTTP headers, TLS certificate, DNS SPF/DMARC/CAA, security.txt). Invalid, SSRF-blocked, or completely unreachable domains incur zero charge.

urls.title: Domains or URLs to Audit (1–100)
urls.description: List of public domains or HTTP(S) URLs to audit (max 100 per run). Example: ["https://example.com", "stripe.com"]. Private/internal IPs and non-80/443 ports are automatically rejected with zero charge.

concurrency.title: Concurrent Domains (1–5)
concurrency.description: Number of domains to audit concurrently in this run (1 to 5). Lower values reduce rate-limiting on shared origins.

timeoutMs.title: Per-Probe Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each HTTP/TLS network probe (500 to 15000 ms, default 4000 ms).

includeMarkdown.title: Include Markdown Executive Summary
includeMarkdown.description: Attach a ready-to-share Markdown summary table and key findings list to each audited domain record.
